## How to review

- [ ] Unit tests cover the behavior (`npm test`)
- [ ] The no-key path still posts a comment
- [ ] Snippets, request bodies, and tokens are not logged
- [ ] `npm run build` was run if `src/` changed, and `dist/index.js` is included
- [ ] Docs or an ADR are updated if the behavior reviewers see has changed
